headline: Update says the new Audit Committee is formed and is scheduling its first meeting to set its calendar and audit scope.
summary: Majority Leader Sarah Gallagher reported that the Audit Committee has been established. Its first meeting will set the committee's calendar, review the audit scope, and schedule a briefing from the Administration and CLA. More public updates will follow.

CONNECTICUT 
 
FINANCE COMMITTEE 
 
MINUTES DRAFT

Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President  
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Finance Committee Meeting, September 28, 2026 – 7pm.  Majority Leader Gallagher 
opened the meeting at 10:12pm with the members noted above in attendance.   
  
 
 
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION – no one came forward to speak 
No one came forward to provide public comment.  
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Majority Leader Gallagher noted the list of boards/commissions listed on the agenda   
  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA  
  1. Informational update on the status of the audit(s) by the Chair of Audit Committee 
Committee Chair and Majority Leader Gallagher provided an informational update on 
the formation of the Audit Committee, advising that the Committee has been 
established and is in the process of scheduling its organizational meeting. She stated 
that the initial meeting will establish the committee's calendar, review the audit scope, 
and schedule a briefing from the Administration and CLA, after which additional 
public updates will be provided.  
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting. .  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting.  
7. ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Majority Leader Gallagher closed the 
meeting at 10:14pm.
